original_pc: MAC0 = DQB + q * (low 32 bits of the address of the DQA register), so the result depends on where Windows loads the DLL; the harness saw it relocated to 0x7ff880a20000
memoria_reference: The same formula over the address of Memoria's own ModuleData copy, which gives another value again
tantalus_default: The address at the DLL's preferred base, 0x80211FAC, every run
evidence: crates/tantalus-sfx/tests/oracle.rs gte_matches_the_dll: the port matches the DLL exactly when given the DLL's load address
rationale: The original value changes from launch to launch; a fixed value keeps effects and replays deterministic. It feeds MAC0 and IR0 (the depth-cue factor) only
